newsitem.title: USA: MBIA Insurance Corp to open San Francisco office.
newsitem.headline: MBIA Insurance Corp to open San Francisco office.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp, a unit of MBIA Inc, said on Monday it would open a San Francisco office headed by Thomas McLoughlin.
McLoughlin, vice president of the western region of MBIA's public finance group, will be joined by at least two other professionals.
The office, which is expected to open early next year, will be used for marketing and deal analysis of municipal issues in MBIA's western region.
MBIA Insurance Corp is a leading insurer of municipal bonds and structured finance transactions.
